31: Their ruling is not a valid ruling, etc. — The Bach wrote that regarding kiddushin (betrothal) one should be stringent like Shmuel, that their ruling is a valid ruling. But in my humble opinion it appears primary that we do not hold like Shmuel, as the Rif, Rambam, Rosh, Tur, and many other poskim ruled, and as is proven in the Gemara, perek HaChovel (Bava Kamma daf 84) and Gittin perek HaMegaresh (Gittin daf 88), and as I wrote above in seif katan 1. And so it is implied in the Gemara, second perek of Kesubos, regarding kiyum (verification of documents), and perek Zeh Borer, regarding odisa (an admission), for it says there: "but perhaps the Rabbanan of the academy of Rav Ashi hold like Shmuel," etc. And what Tosfos wrote there — that we hold like Shmuel regarding kiyum and odisa, and only on this [matter of judging] we do not hold like him — is a great stretch; firstly, because the language of the Gemara does not imply so; and further, because Shmuel only said his statement regarding judging; and further, why should we require three for kiyum and odisa more than for judging? And so ruled the Ravan, daf 111, start of amud gimmel, and the Baal HaIttur daf 51, and the Nimukei Yosef, and the Sma"g, and the Ritva in the second perek of Kesubos, not like Shmuel — see there, and this is primary.
